pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with soft, non-linear edge gradients. Patch density is higher on the neck with smaller spatial areas, transitioning to larger, more elongated geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pelage. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial. Pathway thickness is narrow on the upper neck and widens significantly towards the lower flank and ventral region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged contour along the upper neck and shoulder, created by the vertical projection of short mane hairs.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: A localized structural discontinuity is present on the upper dorsal ridge where an avian organism is perched, occluding the mane's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, localized region of hyper-pigmented, textured disruption is visible on the lower-mid flank, characterized by a greyish-black crusting consistent with skin pathology.
other_distinctive_markers: Two oxpeckers (Buphagus sp.) are perched on the dorsal mane, providing unique temporal visual markers.
